headline: The Co4E visual workflow builder — a node-graph editor with a wave-by-wave execution engine, run modes, run history and custom agent personas — is covered by 14 tickets all marked ready for release, and the code backs up 8 of them while the other 6 could not be confirmed from the code that was examined.
what_is_there: The code shows a working visual workflow canvas (drag-and-drop nodes, zoom, pan, connect and delete), an execution engine that runs nodes in dependency order and passes each step's output into the next, parallel fan-out to sub-agents, automatic self-verification rounds with a configurable limit, run modes for automatic, plan-only and manual step-by-step execution, run history with saved workflow snapshots, and user-defined custom agent personas for workflow steps.
what_is_unclear: Six items could not be settled because the specific code was not among the files reviewed: the full list of node types (Join, IF/Switch, Start, End), conditional IF/Switch branching and the skipping of gated nodes, permission presets (inherit, read-only, standard, full), importing and exporting workflows between instances, and the newer request to add an attachment-folder and URL source to a workflow step. This reflects which files were looked at, not evidence that the features are absent.
suggested_action: Ask the team to point to where conditional branching, permission presets and workflow import/export live, and to confirm whether the attachment-folder and URL fields have been added to the step configuration screen — these can likely be resolved with a short walkthrough.
caveat: Some supporting documentation referenced during the analysis appeared to describe a different product, so it was disregarded; the conclusions above rest on the code itself.
